label: Fuel Surcharge
description: Covers volatile fuel costs. Adjusted weekly based on pump prices. Currently 5% of base rate.

label: VAT (7.5%)
description: Value Added Tax as mandated by Nigerian law (FIRS). Applied to base shipping price + fuel surcharge.

label: Remote Area Fee
description: Applies to deliveries beyond standard urban coverage zones. Flat ₦500 per shipment.
